Markets.title: Safe-haven demand pushes Japan’s 10-year yield to two-month low
Markets.summary: Japanese government bond yields fell to a two-month low on Friday as investors shifted to safer assets following a global selloff in tech stocks. Markets are now focusing on the upcoming Bank of Japan policy meeting to gauge potential changes to inflation and interest rates.

Markets.title: Infinx plans $300 million IPO in India, appoints three bankers
Markets.summary: Healthcare IT firm Infinx Technology Solutions has hired Kotak Mahindra Capital, Nomura, and Avendus to manage a planned $300 million IPO in India targeted for fiscal year 2028. Backed by KKR and Norwest Venture Partners, the company provides AI-powered revenue cycle management services.

Markets.title: Moderna Stock Selloff: Why positive cancer vaccine results failed to lift shares
Markets.summary: Moderna shares dropped after detailed trial results showed its cancer vaccine reduced melanoma recurrence risk by 42%. Investors engaged in profit-taking while weighing the treatment's commercial prospects, regulatory timelines, and future oncology opportunities.

Markets.title: Christopher Wood swapped Nvidia for a Greek infrastructure stock. The bet is paying off
Markets.summary: In October 2025, Jefferies analyst Christopher Wood replaced Nvidia with Greek infrastructure company GEK TERNA in his portfolio. Since the switch, GEK TERNA has gained 65% in US-dollar terms, outperforming Nvidia's 15% increase.

Markets.title: China stocks extend losses as global tech selloff weighs on sentiment
Markets.summary: Chinese stocks extended their losses due to a global technology selloff, Middle East tensions, and French debt concerns. Consequently, the CSI300 index fell into bear-market territory under some definitions, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng index remained relatively steady.

Markets.title: Rs 9,000 crore wiped out in a day: Why Swiggy investors are losing patience with Instamart
Markets.summary: Swiggy shares fell on Friday and lost about ₹9,000 crore in market value after the company reported widening quarterly losses in its Instamart quick-commerce unit. As a result, brokerages reduced their price targets due to concerns over deteriorating profitability.

Geo-Political.title: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC finds
Geo-Political.summary: A BBC investigation reveals that Sudan's RSF fighters have deliberately targeted hospitals. The UN human rights chief states these multiple attacks may constitute war crimes.

Geo-Political.title: Powerful earthquake hits Tibet killing 16 people, reports say
Geo-Political.summary: A powerful earthquake struck a mountainous and sparsely populated area of the Tibet Autonomous Region. The disaster resulted in the deaths of 16 people.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says Musk has restored access to Ukraine's Starlink network
Geo-Political.summary: Donald Trump stated that Elon Musk has restored Ukraine's access to the Starlink satellite network. Ukraine depends on this network for various military operations, despite Musk previously denying any restrictions.

Geo-Political.title: L'Oreal says weight loss drugs are impacting beauty and skincare sales
Geo-Political.summary: L'Oreal's CEO stated that the rising use of GLP-1 weight loss drugs is noticeably affecting the company's beauty and skincare sales. The cosmetics giant considers this pharmaceutical trend to be a significant market phenomenon for its business.

Geo-Political.title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
Geo-Political.summary: Donald Trump is suing the BBC regarding a 2021 Panorama episode that edited together two different parts of his speech. A court has now ordered Trump to answer questions under oath as part of this lawsuit.

Geo-Political.title: Nigeria and Kenya Ebola patients may have crossed paths at Uganda airport, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: Officials report that Ebola patients from Nigeria and Kenya may have crossed paths at Uganda's Entebbe International Airport. Both individuals traveled through the airport on October 3.

Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector activity reached a four-month high in October due to faster manufacturing and services growth, increased new orders, and lower inflation. However, hiring growth slowed to its weakest pace of the year during the same period.

Data & Insights.summary: Taxing the top 1 percent alone is insufficient to resolve income inequality. How governments spend public revenue is equally crucial to achieving true economic justice.

Data & Insights.title: India's Mideast oil imports return to pre-war levels in September
Data & Insights.summary: India's oil imports from the Middle East returned to pre-war levels in September as supply constraints from the Iran conflict eased. Refiners purchased spot cargoes after Middle Eastern producers and traders increased shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.

Data & Insights.title: The story of India’s post-election defection wave since 2022, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Between 2022 and 2026, over 100 Indian lawmakers switched political parties by exploiting loopholes in the anti-defection law. The National Democratic Alliance (NDA) emerged as the primary beneficiary of this defection wave.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC Minutes: Governor Sanjay Malhotra ties future hikes to growth-inflation outlook — here is what he said
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that future interest rate hikes will depend on the evolving growth and inflation outlook. Policymakers expressed differing views on how to balance containing inflation without unnecessarily restricting economic activity.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC minutes reveal 2 members opposed shift from neutral stance to calibrated tightening in October meeting
Data & Insights.summary: Two Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee members opposed shifting the policy stance from neutral to calibrated tightening during the October meeting. Despite this disagreement, all six members unanimously supported raising the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%.

India.title: UP School Van Driver Crushes 8-Year-Old Student To Death While Reversing
India.summary: An eight-year-old student in Uttar Pradesh was crushed to death by her school van driver. The driver reversed the vehicle without checking if the child had reached a safe distance after getting off.

India.title: 'Human Pulled The Trigger, Machine Helped': Ex-CIA Chief On Iran School Bombing
India.summary: A former CIA chief stated that a human, rather than artificial intelligence, pulled the trigger in the bombing of an Iranian school. This statement contradicts an earlier report claiming that an AI "kill chain" was responsible for the US strikes.
